say: That's bread. Real bread. Don't let me smell it.
You carry bread. My stomach knew before I did.
Bread... I can smell it from here.
Is that bread? When did I last...
Stranger, you have bread. We have nothing.
Go on, before the others see.
then.speaker: T_TARGET_IF_PLAYER

say: Thank you... I won't forget it.
You didn't have to. Nobody has to.
Bread. Real bread. Go, go before I start weeping.
Gods. It's soft. Thank you, stranger.
How did it come to this?
then.speaker: T_TARGET_IF_PLAYER

say: The road took them. The road takes everything.
We ate them. Then we ate the rest.
Lost, sold, stolen. It doesn't matter which.
I understand. I'd say the same.
A dustwich. I know the smell.
You have a dustwich in there. I'm not asking. I am... I'm asking.
Is that a dustwich? Dust and gristle.
I can hear that wrapper. Don't tease me.
Something to eat. Anything. That would do.
It's yours. Go easy on it.
then.speaker: T_TARGET_IF_PLAYER

say: It's dust. I don't care. Thank you.
You're kind. It's a poor trade, being kind.
I'll share it. I won't share it.
Thank you. I'm keeping my knife down. See?
I stopped counting. It made it worse.
A day. Three. A dead beetle, once.
Nothing grows near here that doesn't bite back.
With what? These hands shake too much for a knife.
Find my own. Yes. Good advice.
Dried meat. You have dried meat. Do you know what that's worth?
That's meat in your bag. I can smell the salt.
Meat... we haven't had meat since... please.
Stranger. Is that meat? Don't lie.
Dried meat. Is it beast? I don't care. Is it beast?
It's dry. It will keep. Take it.
Take it. Eat it away from me.
then.speaker: T_TARGET_IF_PLAYER

say: Beast. Good. Beast is good. Thank you.
It will keep. I won't let it.
You're strange, giving. We don't see it.
Salt. Real salt. I could cry.
Why do you ask? Is it so rare?
What do you eat out here?
then.speaker: T_TARGET_IF_PLAYER

say: We did. The beasts learned. Now they hunt us.
Rare. Rarer than cats, rarer than water.
Hungry. That's all anyone needs to know.
Whatever is slow. Whatever is dead.
Keep it. It's yours. It's only...
Then walk on. Please walk on.
Raw meat. In your pack. Is it... I wouldn't ask. Is it beast?
I can smell blood on your bag. Meat.
Fresh meat. Oh. Is that for sale? For anything?
You carry raw meat. We could cook it. We have a fire.
That smell is meat. Do not say it is not.
Here. Raw, but it will do.
Take it. And do not ask what.
then.speaker: T_TARGET_IF_PLAYER

say: Beast. Yes. I'll cook it. I'll cook it twice.
We have a fire. We have a fire now. Thank you.
Clean meat. A man could live on this for a day.
Thank you. We'll remember who fed us.
What do you do for food?
then.speaker: T_TARGET_IF_PLAYER

say: We lost the arrows. And the nerve.
We have embers. We guard them.
Whatever we find. Whatever finds us. Do not ask.
It's always worse. Do you know a time it got better?
Of course. We have no right.
Then... go. Please. I'm tired of hoping.
Yes. Sorry. I asked too much.

dialogues.note: Fires when the player carries no listed food (food menus score 12). Money gate via DC_PLAYERMONEY.

say: Cats? Have you cats? Even a few. For food.
We can't buy bread with no money. Do you have any? Please.
Stranger. A few cats. We have nothing left to sell.
You look like you have coin. We have hunger. It isn't a fair trade, I know.
Any cats? We'll remember it. That's all we have, memory.
Take it. Eat before you spend it.
Three hundred. It is all I will give.
Take it, and don't follow me.
then.speaker: T_TARGET_IF_PLAYER

say: Three hundred. Thank you. We won't forget.
You'll have no trouble from us. I'll tell the others.
Thank you. I'm sorry for all of it.
What happened to the rest of you?
then.speaker: T_TARGET_IF_PLAYER

say: There's no work. There's nothing. Do you see anything?
We ran out. Then the others ran out of us.
Work for what? A bowl of dust?
Until the next beast. Or the next stranger.
I see... I see. Go safe.
Everyone has nothing. It's the one thing we share.
Then go. And don't look back at us.
You're as thin as we are. We won't trouble you.
Nothing in your hands? Then we are the same, stranger.
You have nothing to give and neither do we. Ha.
No food. No cats. At least you're honest.
Ask a town. Ask a trader. Ask the dead, they know where it went.
Not here. Move on and pray.
Where the road goes. If you walk long enough something will have fallen over.
There's always a town. There's rarely a welcome.
You too. Don't die before us. It's rude.
Please. Don't hurt us. We only wanted food.
There are too many of you. We are leaving.
We didn't mean it. We never mean it. We're just so hungry.
I'll put it down. See? Don't hurt us.
Thank you. Thank you. We're going.
We won't trouble you again. We'll trouble someone else.
What were you going to do?
Do you ever kill for it?
then.speaker: T_TARGET_IF_PLAYER

say: Eat. That's all. That's always all.
Because we had nothing. Because you had something.
Sometimes. Sometimes we only take. Sometimes we only wish.
Nobody sent us. Nobody sends anyone out here.
It's you. The one who fed us. We say your name quietly, in case it wears out.
Friend. You're welcome here, though there's little to welcome you with.
You came back. Nobody comes back. Sit, if you can bear the smell.
We spoke of you at the fire. It was a good talk. A short one, but good.
Stranger. We owe you. We'll pay when we have anything.
Less hungry. Still hungry. It's a better kind of hungry.
Better, thanks to you. Some of us stopped dreaming of plates.
A little. We make it last. We make it last.
Fewer than before. Thin ones first. That's how it goes.
Anything I should know about the road?
then.speaker: T_TARGET_IF_PLAYER

say: Others like us. Worse than us.
Safer with a friend nearby. That isn't saying much.
Beasts, mostly. And people who would rather be beasts.
Smoke, to the east. Don't go to smoke.
Go. Come back if you can.
We will. We always do. Eventually.

dialogues.note: Followers only; vanilla Bandit hold up needs a leader with squad >3. Gated on Dust Bandits heat < 15 so the pardon menu still shows.

say: Road tax. A hundred and fifty cats and you're on your way.
Hey. You. The boss likes his road paid for.
Stop right there. Pay the toll, a hundred and fifty, and keep your teeth.
You walk, you pay. Hundred and fifty cats.
Cats. A hundred and fifty. Or we find out what you carry the hard way.
A hundred and fifty. Done. (Give 150 Cats)
then.speaker: T_TARGET_IF_PLAYER

say: Nice. You can pass. Nobody touches you.
Then walk fast, mark. I'll remember your face.
Your funeral. I'm only the hand.
Bold. Some day somebody will teach you.
My friends are right behind me.
I wouldn't. There are more of us close by.
Check the dunes. We have you surrounded.
then.speaker: T_TARGET_IF_PLAYER

say: ...Hm. Maybe I don't feel like cats today. Go.
Fine. Fine. Keep it. Walk on.
Right. Not worth it. Move along.
Ha. Nobody behind you but dust.
I can count, you know. You're alone.
You are a bad liar, mark.
Go on. Don't look at me.

dialogues.note: Leaders of squads up to 3; vanilla Bandit hold up covers squads over 3.

say: This is a small group, but a hungry one. Three hundred cats for the road.
Three hundred. The Dust King gets his cut, and so do we.
You want to pass? Three hundred cats.
Look at us. Look at you. Three hundred cats saves us both some trouble.
Toll. Three hundred cats. Fair for the dust.
Sweet. You can pass. Tell nobody.
Then we have nothing to talk about.
Stubborn. It will cost you more later.
We will remember you. We do remember.
Keep going. Don't turn your back.
My crew is in the hills.
You don't want my people finding you.
My squad is behind that ridge.
then.speaker: T_TARGET_IF_PLAYER

say: ...We heard about a crew. Never mind.
Fine. Go. We were never here.
Then go, and don't talk to anyone.
Don't wait for us to change our minds.

dialogues.note: Bandit outnumbered by the player squad; asks to leave. DA_GO_HOME copied from vanilla Starver interrupt.

say: Easy. Easy. We were only looking. We aren't looking for trouble.
There are more of you than us. That's bad arithmetic.
No toll. Forget the toll. We're going.
You have friends. Big friends. We'll go.
Look, nobody has drawn anything. Nobody has to.
Leave before I change my mind.
then.speaker: T_TARGET_IF_PLAYER

say: What do you want from travellers?
Do you work for the Dust King?
then.speaker: T_TARGET_IF_PLAYER

say: The Dust King gets the pile. We get the crumbs.
Cats. Boots. Whatever does not run.
Everyone works for him. Nobody likes him. It's a great arrangement.
Cold, dry, loud. You would hate it.
You owe me for the scare.
then.speaker: T_TARGET_IF_PLAYER

say: Drop them? Not on your life. Cats, no. Leave us alone.
Owe you? Are you joking? We're leaving.
Not a chance. We would sooner fight.
Cats are the only thing we have.
I haven't eaten since the last raid. That's bread? Give me some.
I will trade. Any road is yours, for bread.
Boss doesn't feed us anymore. Is that bread you have?
Take it. Don't rob me later.
then.speaker: T_TARGET_IF_PLAYER

say: Heh. A good one. I won't touch your boots.
Thanks. Do not tell the boss.
Is that meat? Dried? I would stab you for it. Please say you will give it instead.
Meat. A little meat. I will not forget it.
I have not seen meat in days. Not even a rat.
Stranger. Meat. Whatever it costs. I'll pay in favours.
Beast. Good. I can taste the salt already.
You're alright. I'll say so around the camp.
A favour for a favour. Pass freely.
Keep it, then. Choke on it.
I'm so hungry I'd sell my own boots. Do you have any cats?
The boss took my share. Spare some cats for a meal?
A little cat money. For food. I'll even say please.
No raids in days. We're hungry. Some cats?
Take it. Don't rob me later. (Give 300 Cats)
then.speaker: T_TARGET_IF_PLAYER

say: Heh. You're all right. Don't tell the others I said so.
Thanks. You won't hear a word from me.
Cats. Food. Good. I owe you.
Right. Good. You pass freely, with me.
Everyone says no. It hurts less every time.
The Reavers hold this road. Four hundred cats for passage. Or you can serve.
Halt. Four hundred cats, and you're free to go. No cats, you're useful in other ways.
Your road ends here, unless you pay.
This ground is ours. Pay four hundred or we find work for you.
Four hundred cats. Do not insult us by haggling.
The Reavers don't forget a payment.
I don't serve and I don't pay.
then.speaker: T_TARGET_IF_PLAYER

say: Then you'll be remembered as a fool.
Mistake. We shall see to it later.
Not today. We will remember your face.
Wise to keep walking. Do so.
My army is just behind me.
You're outnumbered. My squad is close.
My people are in those hills.
then.speaker: T_TARGET_IF_PLAYER

say: A fight over a toll? No. Pass.
The Reavers know when to wait.
I see no one. Pay, or serve.
Stand down. We're outnumbered. We won't fight today.
Your numbers are greater. We withdraw.
No toll. We're leaving. Don't follow.
The old lands, back. Every stone of them.
Armies eat. Armies pay. That's all.
A banner. And those who believe in it.
To return. And to be paid, meanwhile.

dialogues.note: Refusal ('Come and take it') ends in DA_ATTACK_CHASE_FOREVER like vanilla refusals; the reply is labelled as a challenge.

say: Swamp road. Two hundred and fifty cats and you walk it.
Nobody crosses here for free. Two fifty, cats.
Mud is ours. Walking in it costs two hundred and fifty.
You paid for the boots. Now pay for the ground. Two fifty.
Two hundred and fifty. Or the swamp keeps you.
Good. Mud is yours for a bit.
Fine. Pass. Don't come back with friends.
Then it is the sword. Get him!
We'll take it from the body.
My squad is in the reeds.
then.speaker: T_TARGET_IF_PLAYER

say: Hold on, hold on. We aren't looking for a fight.
Forget the toll. Forget it all.
Nobody is hurt. Let us leave.
Ask the Red Bandit. If you survive the asking.
Anything that floats. Anything that sinks.
Because nobody follows us into it.
Nobody lives out here. We only stay.
Hold. The Band of Bones holds these lands now. Three hundred cats to pass.
This is ours. Three hundred cats, or the sand gets you.
You walk on bone. Three hundred cats, flatskin.
Pay the Band its due. Three hundred.
Three hundred. We do not ask twice.
Then walk wide of our fires.
There are many more of us.
then.speaker: T_TARGET_IF_PLAYER

say: The Band will not fight today. Go.
A toll isn't worth a war.
Fine. Pass. Don't boast of it.
We know when to wait. Go.
Enough. We're fewer today. The Band withdraws.
You are too many. We will wait.
We go. We return when we're many.
Warriors without a kingdom. We make our own.
Those who earned it. Not a thing you ask lightly.
A kingdom needs bones. We provide them.

dialogues.note: Grass Pirates already have fd_gp_talk (no score); chance 55 leaves it reachable. Refusal ends in attack as the reply is a challenge.

say: Oi. Coast toll. Two hundred and fifty cats and you sail on by.
Stop where ya are. Two fifty for the coast. Yer lucky it's cheap.
Pirates' tax, mate. Two hundred and fifty.
Coast road. Pay two fifty or we take it off the body.
Two fifty cats. Or the tide takes ya.
That's the way. Don't tell the Cities.
We take it off the body, then.
My crew is behind the dunes.
My friends are by the beach.
then.speaker: T_TARGET_IF_PLAYER

say: Ha. Not worth it. Go on.
Liar. I see the sea. Cats.
Right. Right. Too many. We're off.
Steady, steady. No fight. We go.
Off we go. No hard feelings.
Do you live on the coast?
then.speaker: T_TARGET_IF_PLAYER

say: Ask the sea. It answers in drownings.
Because the sea is wide and the law isn't.
Where the water ends, the land begins.

dialogues.note: Skipped while the player carries someone (vanilla/captives pc_buy_hunters handles that).

say: Hold. We hunt runaways. Your papers, or two hundred cats for our troubles.
Not slave, not hunted? Then pay two hundred and we forget your face.
Two hundred, traveller. Hunters don't work for free, and neither do the blind.
Mm. You look like loose property. Two hundred and you are not.
Pay the road tax, two hundred. Or we check what you are.
Hunters know a paid face. Go.
Your choice. We'll keep an eye on you.
Proud, for a free man. Go.
Hmph. No profit in it. Go.
Careful. There are a good many of you. We aren't here to fight.
We hunt runaways, not armies. We go.
Runaways. Anyone with a collar and nowhere to go.
Enough to keep a hunter fed.
The ones who lost something. Not always the same ones.
Toll. Two hundred cats. This road is ours.
Pay two hundred cats. The road requires it.
Two hundred cats to pass. State your decision.
You're in our territory. The price is two hundred cats.
Then go. We have registered you.
No one is behind you. Pay.
No toll will be taken. We go.
The road. And whatever travels on it.
Because someone must. And we can.
